title: Verify auth flow end-to-end (Session 8 smoke test)
description: Session 8 implemented the full auth system. Manual smoke test required before building on top of it: (1) Login with valid credentials → saleor_token + saleor_refresh_token cookies set, user name shown in header. (2) Login with wrong password → INVALID_CREDENTIALS error displayed. (3) Register new account without email confirmation → auto-login, redirect to /. (4) Register with email confirmation enabled → 'check your email' screen shown. (5) Logout → cookies cleared, Sign In button restored. (6) Token near-expiry → middleware /api/auth/refresh called silently. (7) Forgot password form → success message shown regardless of email. (8) Test all flows in both en and ar locales. (9) Test /login and /register standalone pages redirect to / if already logged in.
close_reason: Auth flow verified clean — all 5 routes (login, register, logout, refresh, forgot-password), AuthContext, layout seeding, UserMenu, and i18n keys confirmed correct in both en/ar locales

title: Fix Logo image not loading (flex-shrink + verify end-to-end)
description: Logo disappeared after Session 8 because the new UserMenu text button made Nav wider, and Logo lacked shrink-0 protection. A CSS fix (shrink-0) was applied in the last commit. Still needs verification: (1) confirm public/logo.png loads correctly on all pages in both LTR and RTL, (2) check for any 307 redirect or file-casing issue on the server, (3) confirm the Logo displays at correct size on mobile (375px) and desktop.
close_reason: Fixed logo 307 redirect: middleware matcher updated to exclude paths with file extensions (.*\..*). /logo.png now passes through without next-intl intercepting it.

title: Build /reset-password page (set password from email token)
description: The forgot-password flow (Session 8) sends an email with a link to /reset-password?token=...&email=.... This page does not exist yet. Build: (1) src/app/[locale]/[channel]/(main)/reset-password/page.tsx — reads token + email from searchParams, renders a SetPasswordForm. (2) src/ui/components/auth/SetPasswordForm.tsx — fields: newPassword + confirmPassword, client-side match validation, submits to new Route Handler. (3) src/app/api/auth/set-password/route.ts — calls Saleor setPassword mutation with token+email+password. On success: show confirmation + redirect to /login. On error: show specific error message (INVALID or expired token).

title: Add change password form to account dashboard
description: Authenticated users should be able to change their password from the account page. (1) New Route Handler: src/app/api/auth/change-password/route.ts — calls Saleor passwordChange mutation (oldPassword, newPassword) with Authorization: Bearer <token> from cookie. (2) New component: src/ui/components/auth/ChangePasswordForm.tsx — fields: currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword. Client-side validation: passwords match + min 8 chars. (3) Wire into account dashboard page as a collapsible section or separate card. (4) On success: show confirmation toast/message. On error: map error codes (INVALID_PASSWORD, PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT, etc.) via auth.errors i18n namespace.

title: Build /account dashboard page (protected)
description: Add a protected account dashboard page at src/app/[locale]/[channel]/(main)/account/page.tsx. Requirements: (1) Server-side auth guard — redirect to /login if saleor_token cookie is absent. (2) Display user's firstName, lastName, email from AuthContext (seeded from JWT on server). (3) Use Container layout, design tokens (surface-*, content-*, brand-*), mobile-first. (4) Link to account page from the UserMenu dropdown ('My Account'). (5) Account page acts as the hub for future sub-features (change password, order history).

title: Replace neutral-* hardcoded colors in CartNavItem and MobileMenu
description: Several nav components still use Tailwind's hardcoded neutral-* palette instead of design tokens, noted as a known issue in CLAUDE.md since Session 7. (1) src/ui/components/nav/components/CartNavItem.tsx — badge and icon colors. (2) src/ui/components/nav/components/MobileMenu.tsx — drawer background, link colors, overlay. Replace neutral-200/500/700/800 etc. with the corresponding surface-*, content-*, and line-* tokens so the components respond correctly to dark mode (data-theme=dark) and brand updates. The UserMenu was already rewritten in Session 8 so it no longer uses neutral-*.
